description: Henrico, VA – Today, prosecutor Shannon Taylor launched her first general election TV ad in her campaign for Congress in Virginia’s 1st Congressional District. The ad, "Prosecutor," spotlights her record keeping Virginians safe and her backing from law enforcement officers across the Commonwealth.
